title: •Let’s Pass On That
caption: Bantha Fodder (V)
game_text: During opponent’s control phase, your ferocious creature attacks. At end of turn, if that creature is at an unoccupied site and did not move, opponent loses 1 Force and you retrieve 1 Force. OR Use 3 Force to retrieve a creature.
lore: “Uu a’kingsa riika pagh bagla bis kachata weenow con bantha poodoo.”

During opponent’s control phase, your ferocious
creature attacks. At end of turn, if that creature is at
